title: pubid differential report
description: One run of the three-engine differential runner (crates/differential): the same randomized attested inputs through Ruby, Rust, and TS, each engine's verdict per case, and the classified drifts. The site's dashboard consumes this shape; drifts never gate, this is a data generator.

schema.description: The report shape version. Bump on any breaking change here.

seed.description: The splitmix64 seed; a run replays byte-identically from it.

inputs.description: corpus-mined = generated from the vendored slices; explicit = a --inputs file.

stamp.description: Optional run timestamp (--stamp); null keeps output byte-stable for fixture comparisons.

drifts.description: Cases whose delta_class is acceptance_drift or output_drift.

cases.description: Per-case records. Default: drifts only (--include-agree adds every case).

version.description: The engine's own version (gem version, npm version, crate version).

detail.description: Why an engine is unavailable, or null.

status.description: ok = parsed; reject = the engine refused the input; unimplemented = the engine has no such flavor; error = the engine crashed or panicked.

hash.description: The canonical to_hash record, present only for ok. Compared deep-equal across engines.

human.description: The canonical human spelling, present only for ok.

urn.description: The emitted URN; null when the flavor emits none.

detail.description: The reject error code (Ruby's neutral vocabulary, TS parse_failed, Rust's error text) or the crash detail.

origin.description: row = a sampled canonical corpus row; mutant = a structurally mutated row; recombination = a mined facet template splice; explicit = from --inputs.

delta_class.description: agree = every comparable engine gave the same verdict (both-reject included); acceptance_drift = the engines disagree on accept/reject; output_drift = all parsed but hash/human/urn differ; single_engine = fewer than two comparable engines.

detail.description: output_drift: the differing field pairs; acceptance_drift: the per-engine statuses; single_engine: the statuses; agree: null.

engines.description: Keyed by engine (rust, ruby, ts) for every engine that ran the case.
